# @AUTOGENERATED by scripts/gen_sol_mnt_compat.py - do not edit; run the generator.
# Restore vanilla gold-transfer scaling; M&T does not replace these effects.
REPLACE:change_gold_effect = {
	add_gold = {
		value = 1
		multiply = $scale$

		add = {
			value = capital_wealth
			multiply = $scale$
			multiply = 0.2
		}
		add = {
			value = country_economical_base
			multiply = $scale$
			multiply = 0.05
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				$scale$ >  0
			}
			min = {
				value = $scale$
			}
			max = {
				value = 5000
				multiply = $scale$
			}

		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				$scale$ < 0
			}
			max = {
				value = $scale$
			}
			min = {
				value = 5000
				multiply = $scale$
			}

		}
	}
}

REPLACE:change_estate_gold_effect = {

	add_gold_to_estate = {
		estate_type = $estate$
		value = {
			value = $scale$

			add = {
				value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax
				multiply = $scale$
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					$scale$ >  0
				}
				min = {
					value = $scale$
				}
				max = {	
					value = 5000
					multiply = $scale$
				}

			}
			
			if = {
				limit = {
					$scale$ < 0
				}
				max = {
					value = $scale$
				}
				min = {	
					value = 5000
					multiply = $scale$
				}

			}
		}
	}
}

					multiply = local_var:sol_market_effective_price_wine
				}
			}
		}

		remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_nobles key = scope:sol_market_cache }
		add_to_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_nobles key = scope:sol_market_cache value = local_var:sol_market_nobles_unit_spending }
		remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_clergy key = scope:sol_market_cache }
		add_to_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_clergy key = scope:sol_market_cache value = local_var:sol_market_clergy_unit_spending }
		remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_burghers key = scope:sol_market_cache }
		add_to_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_burghers key = scope:sol_market_cache value = local_var:sol_market_burghers_unit_spending }
		remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_laborers key = scope:sol_market_cache }
		add_to_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_laborers key = scope:sol_market_cache value = local_var:sol_market_laborers_unit_spending }
		remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_peasants key = scope:sol_market_cache }
		add_to_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_peasants key = scope:sol_market_cache value = local_var:sol_market_peasants_unit_spending }
		remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_soldiers key = scope:sol_market_cache }
		add_to_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_soldiers key = scope:sol_market_cache value = local_var:sol_market_soldiers_unit_spending }
		remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_tribesmen key = scope:sol_market_cache }
		add_to_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_unit_spending_tribesmen key = scope:sol_market_cache value = local_var:sol_market_tribesmen_unit_spending }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = sol_market_pop_demand_maps_initialized value = 1 }
}

# M&T calculation preserved byte-for-byte outside SOL_MNT marker sections.
REPLACE:epbm_calculate_maintenance = {
	set_local_variable = { name = epbm_total_cost value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = epbm_crown_total_cost value = 0 }
	# SOL_MNT_BEGIN location_cache_init
	save_temporary_scope_as = sol_mnt_maintenance_country
	if = {
		limit = { num_locations > 0 }
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { is_land = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sol_mnt_raw_shared_cost value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_mnt_raw_assigned_nobles value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_mnt_raw_assigned_clergy value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_mnt_raw_assigned_burghers value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_mnt_raw_assigned_peasants value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_mnt_raw_assigned_tribes value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_mnt_raw_assigned_dhimmi value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_mnt_raw_assigned_cossacks value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_nobles value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_clergy value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_burghers value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_commoners value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_tribesmen value = 0 }
		}
	}
	# SOL_MNT_END location_cache_init

	epbm_for_each_estate = { effect = epbm_init_estate_var }

	every_estate = {
		limit = { estate_type != estate_type:crown_estate }
		save_temporary_scope_as = epbm_cur_estate

		every_building_owned_by_estate = {
			save_temporary_scope_as = epbm_bldg
			building_type ?= { save_temporary_scope_as = epbm_bt }
			location ?= { market ?= { save_temporary_scope_as = epbm_mkt } }

			epbm_price_building = yes

			if = { limit = { local_var:epbm_bldg_cost > 0 } epbm_route_estate_building_cost = yes }
			# SOL_MNT_BEGIN estate_building_cache
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:epbm_bldg_cost > 0 }
				sol_mnt_cache_estate_building_cost = yes
			}
			# SOL_MNT_END estate_building_cache
		}
	}

	every_owned_building = {
		limit = {
			is_opened = yes
			NOT = {
				building_type = { is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = epbm_blacklist target = this } }
			}
			NOT = { building_category = estate_category }
		}

		save_temporary_scope_as = epbm_bldg
		building_type ?= { save_temporary_scope_as = epbm_bt }
		location ?= { market ?= { save_temporary_scope_as = epbm_mkt } }

		epbm_price_building = yes

		if = { limit = { local_var:epbm_bldg_cost > 0 } epbm_route_building_cost = yes }
		# SOL_MNT_BEGIN shared_building_cache
		if = {
			limit = {
				local_var:epbm_bldg_cost > 0
				building_category != government_category
			}
			location = {
				if = {
					limit = { owner = scope:sol_mnt_maintenance_country }
					change_variable = { name = sol_mnt_raw_shared_cost add = local_var:epbm_bldg_cost }
				}
			}
		}
		# SOL_MNT_END shared_building_cache
	}

	every_owned_foreign_building = {
		limit = {
			is_opened = yes
			NOT = {
				building_type = { is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = epbm_blacklist target = this } }
			}
			NOT = { building_category = estate_category }
		}

		save_temporary_scope_as = epbm_bldg
		building_type ?= { save_temporary_scope_as = epbm_bt }
		location ?= { market ?= { save_temporary_scope_as = epbm_mkt } }

		epbm_price_building = yes

		if = { limit = { local_var:epbm_bldg_cost > 0 } epbm_route_building_cost = yes }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { local_var:epbm_total_cost > 0 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = epbm_shared_fraction
			value = {
				value = local_var:epbm_total_cost
				divide = { value = local_var:epbm_total_cost add = local_var:epbm_crown_total_cost }
			}
		}
	}
	else = { set_local_variable = { name = epbm_shared_fraction value = 0 } }

	epbm_for_each_estate = { effect = epbm_compute_modifier_scale }

	set_variable = { name = epbm_charge_factor value = { value = epbm_cost_share multiply = epbm_inflation_factor } }

	change_local_variable = { name = epbm_total_cost multiply = var:epbm_charge_factor }

	epbm_split_by_estate_power = yes
	epbm_add_estate_building_costs = yes
	# SOL_MNT_BEGIN location_cache_finalize
	set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_charge_factor value = var:epbm_charge_factor }
	set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_power_nobles value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_power_clergy value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_power_burghers value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_power_peasants value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_power_tribes value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_power_cossacks value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_include_tribes value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate } set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_power_nobles value = "estate_power(estate_type:nobles_estate)" } }
	if = { limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:clergy_estate } set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_power_clergy value = "estate_power(estate_type:clergy_estate)" } }
	if = { limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:burghers_estate } set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_power_burghers value = "estate_power(estate_type:burghers_estate)" } }
	if = { limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:peasants_estate } set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_power_peasants value = "estate_power(estate_type:peasants_estate)" } }
	if = { limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:cossacks_estate } set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_power_cossacks value = "estate_power(estate_type:cossacks_estate)" } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_has_estate = estate_type:tribes_estate
			NOT = { is_gaelic_clans = yes }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_include_tribes value = 1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sol_mnt_power_tribes value = "estate_power(estate_type:tribes_estate)" }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { num_locations > 0 }
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { is_land = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_nobles value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_nobles add = { value = var:sol_mnt_raw_assigned_nobles multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_charge_factor } }
			change_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_nobles add = { value = var:sol_mnt_raw_shared_cost multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_power_nobles multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_charge_factor } }

			set_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_clergy value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_clergy add = { value = var:sol_mnt_raw_assigned_clergy multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_charge_factor } }
			change_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_clergy add = { value = var:sol_mnt_raw_shared_cost multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_power_clergy multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_charge_factor } }

			set_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_burghers value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_burghers add = { value = var:sol_mnt_raw_assigned_burghers multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_charge_factor } }
			change_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_burghers add = { value = var:sol_mnt_raw_shared_cost multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_power_burghers multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_charge_factor } }

			set_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_commoners value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_commoners add = { value = var:sol_mnt_raw_assigned_peasants multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_charge_factor } }
			change_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_commoners add = { value = var:sol_mnt_raw_shared_cost multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_power_peasants multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_charge_factor } }

			set_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_tribesmen value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_tribesmen add = { value = var:sol_mnt_raw_assigned_cossacks multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_charge_factor } }
			change_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_tribesmen add = { value = var:sol_mnt_raw_shared_cost multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_power_cossacks multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_charge_factor } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:sol_mnt_include_tribes > 0 }
				change_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_tribesmen add = { value = var:sol_mnt_raw_assigned_tribes multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_charge_factor } }
				change_variable = { name = sol_location_estate_building_maintenance_tribesmen add = { value = var:sol_mnt_raw_shared_cost multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_power_tribes multiply = local_var:sol_mnt_charge_factor } }
			}
		}
	}
	# SOL_MNT_END location_cache_finalize

	set_variable = {
		name = epbm_crown_pool_cost
		value = { value = local_var:epbm_total_cost multiply = "estate_power(estate_type:crown_estate)" }
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = epbm_crown_bldg_cost
		value = { value = local_var:epbm_crown_total_cost multiply = var:epbm_charge_factor }
	}
}

sol_mnt_cache_estate_building_cost = {
	epbm_for_each_estate = { effect = sol_mnt_cache_current_estate_building_cost }
}

sol_mnt_cache_current_estate_building_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:epbm_cur_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:$estate$_estate }
			location = { owner = scope:sol_mnt_maintenance_country }
		}
		location = {
			change_variable = { name = sol_mnt_raw_assigned_$estate$ add = local_var:epbm_bldg_cost }
		}
	}
}
